fact: Enumeration of the 2026 Population and Housing Census, reference night 11 April 2026, has concluded with mop-up operations continuing in Maseru and cattle pounds; over 8,000 temporary field staff were employed; Bureau of Statistics says results come after review.

Government states enumeration of the 2026 Housing and Population Census concluded, with mop-up in Maseru and cattle pounds; results not yet published; no enumeration date given, so the document date 2026-06-05 is used.
Statistics South Africa handed 2,750 tablets and 1,045 power banks to the Bureau of Statistics for the 2026 census, which was set for 12 April, and the Bureau was running supervisor training.
The Bureau's summary of the 2016 Population and Housing Census reports a population of 2,007,201; enumeration date not given, so the census year is used.

The Bureau of Statistics was engaging and deploying enumerators for the 2026 Population and Housing Census, with payment delays and an internal probe into enumerators outside the approved lists; the article does not say the count was completed, and is dated by its published date.
The Independent Electoral Commission report states the last population census before the 2012 elections was conducted in 2006.
